players.name: Ronald Acuna Jr.
players.current_status: ACTIVE - Hit 200th career home run on Sep 2 2026. Activated from 10-day IL on Jul 27 2026 after 38-game absence with left hamstring strain. 2023 NL MVP (41HR / 73SB). Pre-injury 2026: .251/.373/.421, 7HR, 22RBI, 15SB. Post-activation 2026: .243/.345/.416, 80H, 14HR, 39RBI, 50R, 13 2B, 1SB in 87 games.

last_injury.type: Grade 1 left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence in 2026)
last_injury.details: Strained left hamstring running out ground ball vs Chicago White Sox Jun 9. 2nd hamstring strain in 2026 (first was May 3-19, 15 days). Also had left fibula non-displaced fracture in Spring Training (Mar 3 2026) - resolved pre-season. Began rehab FCL Jul 13, transferred to Triple-A Gwinnett Jul 17, activated Jul 27. All rehab gates cleared: BP/throwing/straight-line, cutting drills, outfield work, MiLB rehab, MLB activation. Grand slam in FCL rehab (423ft, 112.8mph exit velocity).
last_injury.current_injury: None acute. Chronic DH management and OB-sprint considerations due to recurring hamstring and ACL history.
last_injury.manager_quote: He's probably as strong as he's ever been. When he comes back, we want him to be able to go. We're going to make sure he is ready to go when we do turn him loose. - Walt Weiss, Braves manager, Jul 26 2026

last_injury.name: Mookie Betts
last_injury.current_status: ACTIVE - No injuries. Minor stiff lower back (Jul 11 day-to-day, NOT IL). Resolved right wrist soreness (Jul 2, missed 1 game). All residual post-viral fatigue from 2025 fully resolved. On a 7-game hitting streak as of late August 2026, batting .355 over last 15 games.

last_injury.details: Injured right oblique while running bases in first inning vs Washington Nationals Apr 4. MRI confirmed mild oblique strain; placed on IL Apr 5. Progression: med ball throws May 4, two rehab starts at Triple-A OKC May 9-11, officially activated May 12 vs Giants. Optioned Alex Freeland to OKC. 32 PA with 99 wRC+ before IL.
last_injury.current_injury: Minor stiff lower back (day-to-day, no IL expected). Resolved right wrist soreness missed 1 game.
last_injury.manager_quote: He felt it as he was running. - Dave Roberts re: oblique strain, Apr 4 2026. I'm able to throw. Running, I feel it, but it's not that bad. I haven't started hitting yet but we're doing med ball throws. - Mookie Betts, May 4 2026. He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot - we're just managing day-to-day. - Dave Roberts re: lower back, Jul 11 2026

career_injury_timeline.outcome: Missed 1 game; returned next day; resolved

last_injury.name: Freddie Freeman
last_injury.current_status: ACTIVE and HEALTHY - All acute injuries fully resolved. Aug 12 dugout fall: body soreness only, no fractures, no structural damage, no imaging needed. Aug 5 HBP to right hand: X-rays negative, remained in game. Chronic ankle managed via load management - plays 118 of 121 games Dodgers played in 2026.

last_injury.type: Body soreness from dugout fall / right hand contusion from HBP - both resolved
last_injury.il_return_date: N/A - did not go on IL
last_injury.details: Hit by 88 mph sinker to right hand vs Cubs at Wrigley Field on Aug 5, X-rays negative, day-day; played next game. Aug 12 ran full-field, tripped over warning track, went down 1st base dugout stairs at KC Royals stadium - knees, shoulder, hand, and wrist soreness; did not hit head. Cold-tubbed immediately. Day-to-day only (no absences from next-day lineup). Returned to game next day, 3-for-5 on Aug 18 vs Brewers (3-for-5, 2R, 1RBI, 1 2B) - first extra-base hit since Jul 26 double.
last_injury.current_injury: None acute. Chronic right ankle post-debridement and left ankle managed via load management and positional shifts.
last_injury.manager_quote: We dodged a bullet. - Dave Roberts on Freddie Freeman's Aug 12 fall (via The Big Lead). I didn't hit my head, so that was the key part there... I am sore. Kneecaps are sore, shoulder is sore, hand is sore, wrist sore. I mean, I fell. I'm in good spirits. - Freddie Freeman (after Aug 12 fall). He's the best 1B in the National League and maybe the best in the world. - Dave Roberts, Jul 27 2026 at Citi Field.
